mixed.note: Retained sizes use dominators of the snapshot graph with weak edges excluded; this is not the DevTools ephemeron-aware retention model. Categories are disjoint shallow sums. Dominator rows can contain other rows and overlap categories; do not add these views. Native DOM/external allocations do not equal Runtime.getHeapUsage. New bytes mean object IDs absent from the baseline, not net growth.

inverseEditStrings.note: Unique string nodes reachable from inverse edit text, including sliced/cons parents. Other owners can share these bytes; this is not exclusive retained size.
